summary: Reproduced the ROCm contradiction: is_hip() was true while DUAL_STREAM_TOKEN_THRESHOLD was 0, so no positive q_lora token count could enable either DSA dual-stream path. The threshold now applies to CUDA and HIP, and both indexers use one explicit token-count gate. Regression coverage verifies 0, 1, 1024, and 1025 tokens, capture/stream prerequisites, the inclusive boundary, and the large-batch single-stream fallback. Raw logs are retained under /job/artifacts/j-5be34f35642d; changed source is under /job/repo/python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/dsa.
